SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.images, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.user_id, u.nickname AS seller_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, p.status, p.view_count, p.create_time, 1 AS favorited FROM t_favorite f INNER JOIN t_product p ON f.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted = 0
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
